**Tests (`version_test.go` per package, 7 passing, `go vet` clean, `gofmt` clean):**

| Test | Asserts |
|---|---|
| mcp `TestVersionFlagRegistered` | flag on global `flag.CommandLine`, default `false` |
| mcp `TestVersionFlagPrintsVersion` | subprocess runs real `main()` with `--version`: rc=0, stdout contains `version.String()`, **no `serving on stdio` marker on stderr**, completes within 5s timeout (no stdin hang) |
| daemon `TestVersionFlagRegistered` | `--version` on the custom `FlagSet` |
| daemon `TestVersionFlagPrintsVersion` | rc=0, stdout == `version.String()` |
| daemon `TestVersionFlagSkipsPIDFileDefaulting` | **early return before defaulting**: default PID path (redirected to temp dir) is never created |
| daemon `TestVersionFlagWithPidfileArg` | `--pidfile X --version` returns 0 and never writes X |
| daemon `TestVersionVarKeptForStatusJSON` | local `Version` == `internal/version.Version`, wired into controller status payload |

**Live probe** (built via `make`, commit `70ac5a6`):

```
$ make probe
v0.1.0-70ac5a6     # openapi-cli
v0.1.0-70ac5a6     # openapi-mcp
v0.1.0-70ac5a6     # openapi-daemon
OK: all binaries report identical version v0.1.0-70ac5a6
```

**Edge cases tested:**
- **rc=0** for all three `--version` invocations; single-dash `-version` also works (stdlib accepts both).
- **Format regex** `^v0\.1\.0-[0-9a-f]{7}$` matches all three.
- **mcp stdin-hang regression guard:** running without `--version` prints `serving on stdio` and blocks (killed by timeout, rc=124); with `--version` it exits rc=0 instantly and the marker never appears — proving the early `return` precedes server start.
- **daemon usage-error path preserved:** `--bogus` still exits rc=2 with usage; the usage text now includes `-version`.
- **No-ldflags dev build** degrades gracefully to `v0.1.0-dev-none`.
